YoWASP Clang 22.0.0-git20542-10 (npm @yowasp/clang@22.0.0-git20542-10): Clang + LLD built for
WebAssembly, with the wasi-libc and libc++ sysroot (target wasm32-wasip1).
https://yowasp.org/  https://github.com/YoWASP/clang
Files clang-core.pack.js and clang-rest.pack.js are built by ../make-packs.js from gen/bundle.js,
gen/llvm.core*.wasm and gen/llvm-resources.tar of the package (gzip + base64, unchanged bytes;
bundle.js gets import.meta.url replaced and its export list turned into a global).
